title: 口语练习
subtitle: 每天 10 分钟 · 共 5 天
steps: 点 🔊 听一遍，听清语调
一句一句跟着读，声音要大，不怕错
读完点「今天完成了」打卡

sentences.en: What do you want to be in the future?
I want to be an engineer.
I will try my best to achieve my goal.
sentences.zh: 我会尽力实现我的目标。

sentences.en: You should keep on doing push-ups every day.
sentences.zh: 你应该每天坚持做俯卧撑。

sentences.en: Make sure you stick to your plan.
sentences.zh: 确保你坚持自己的计划。

sentences.en: My New Year resolution is to read more books.
sentences.zh: 我的新年决心是多读书。

sentences.en: Are you tired of the same old routine?
sentences.zh: 你厌倦了一成不变的日常吗？

sentences.en: A mini-goal can make big changes.
sentences.zh: 一个小目标能带来大改变。

sentences.en: Last but not least, believe in yourself.
sentences.zh: 最后但同样重要的是，要相信自己。
